author: neal_illustrator
title: Looking for artists to help build comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic design collaboration including character visuals
content: [Hiring] Exhibition graphic design project collaboration. Preparing an exhibition at Huashan, Taipei in early December. Seeking a graphic designer for: main visual, wordmark, character visual design (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, one banner flag, other exhibition derivatives (hanging scrolls, panels), pre-press proofing and size confirmation. Timeline: early Oct first draft main visual & wordmark; mid Oct final; early Nov all output designs; mid Nov print; early Dec exhibition. Looking for exhibition/graphic design experience, hand-drawn Japanese warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote. Contact: DM @willai3213 on Threads.
